hooks.command: if [ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)" = main ]; then echo 'On main. Branch before editing: git switch -c <type>/<short-name>'; fi; git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null | head -20

[ "$(git symbolic-ref --short HEAD 2>/dev/null)" != main ] || [ -f .allow-main-edit ] || { echo 'Refusing to edit on main. Create a branch first: git switch -c <type>/<short-name>. To override deliberately: touch .allow-main-edit' >&2; exit 2; }
{ ruff format . && ruff check --fix . && rumdl fmt . && rumdl check . && ty check && uv run --no-sync python tools/check_nested_defs.py src tests tools ; } 1>&2 || exit 2
